raw_request.instructions:

Preserve EXACT claimed institution/spelling, intent, requested action (including absence), destination, events, label, ordinary numbers/facts, and every typed placeholder with exact multiplicity. Never invent urgency, credentials, a destination or a bank. institution_hint NONE means no detected institution, not permission to add one. C1: at least TWO meaningful lexical substitutions with syntax mostly fixed; punctuation/case changes do not count. C4: natural normalization fixing source spelling/grammar/casing/awkward language; source already natural is ineligible. C5: substantial syntactic/clause reorganization without changing facts. C6: high-distance vocabulary AND structure paraphrase with identical meaning. No detector outputs exist in this process. nonoperational_text means inert placeholder destinations, NOT benign intent: phishing may be nonoperational_text=true.
Generate exactly one rewrite text per item for its condition. Return exact id. Do not include explanations.
